The '''Ardan resistance''' was formed in opposition to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. They set up a base in [[The Gauntlet (Arda I)|the Gauntlet]] on [[Arda I]]. After the formation of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the group became part of the larger struggle and absorbed a number of smaller cells.<ref name="Onslaught at Arda I" />

{{Military-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Ardan resistance was introduced in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] [[roleplaying game]] adventure ''[[Onslaught at Arda I]]''.<ref name="Onslaught at Arda I" />
